name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: The angler who landed the Carp has a higher weight than Wade.
The angler who landed the Bluegill's weight is immediately below Mabel.
The angler at Mossbank's weight is immediately below Esther.
Mabel's weight is at least 2 lb more than the angler at Mossbank.
13 lb goes with exactly two of Mabel, Bass, and Pinehollow.
